item.title: Wealth Tax Watch · Issue 01 · September 2026
item.description: Issue 01 of Wealth Tax Watch: California’s Proposition 40 polls, France’s Cour des comptes wealth levy, Canadian and UK proposals, and where BRICS, the G20 and the UN tax convention stand. September 1-23, 2026.
